roadmap.title: Story playthrough
roadmap.description: Play the 13-chapter story on any difficulty and pick up the open-world unlocks you pass along the way: street fights, skills and stats, substories, Troublr, minigames, Clan Creator and city activities.

roadmap.title: Post-game completion
roadmap.description: Continue in Premium Adventure after the credits to finish every substory, Completion List item, minigame, Clan Creator objective and stat cap, then defeat Amon.

roadmap.title: Legend difficulty clear
roadmap.description: Clear the final chapter on LEGEND difficulty, then claim the platinum achievement once every other achievement is done.

achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in the game.

guide.context: This meta-achievement has no task of its own; it appears only after every other achievement on the list is done.

steps.text: Unlock every other achievement in the game, and The Song of Life unlocks by itself.

achievements.description: Arrived in Kamurocho for the first time.
achievements.summary: Arrive in Kamurocho with Kiryu for the first time during the story.

steps.text: Play the opening story until Kiryu returns to Kamurocho; the achievement unlocks during the scene.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 2 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2 until its closing results screen.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 4 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 until its closing results screen.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 6 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 6 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 6 until its closing results screen.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 8 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 8 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 8 until its closing results screen.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 10 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 10 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 10 until its closing results screen.

achievements.description: Completed Chapter 12 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 12 of the main story.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 12 until its closing results screen.

achievements.estTime: at the end of the story
achievements.summary: Complete the final chapter of the main story.

steps.text: Finish the last story chapter and let the ending play out.

achievements.description: Completed the game on LEGEND difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear the final chapter on LEGEND difficulty.

guide.context: LEGEND only appears once you have cleared the game on any difficulty, and you can switch to it from the phone options. That means this can be a short repeat of the final chapter rather than a whole second campaign.

steps.text: Clear the game once on any difficulty to unlock LEGEND.
In the final chapter, when Nagumo asks at Serena whether you are ready to go, answer no and save into two separate manual slots.
Finish the story once so LEGEND becomes available, then load the second save, which still has no clear data.
Open the phone options, set the difficulty to LEGEND, and complete the final chapter again. The achievement unlocks at the results screen.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substories are the blue speech-balloon side quests. They remain available during the story and in post-game Premium Adventure, so none can be lost.

steps.text: Finish any 10 substories; the achievement counts each one as it resolves.

achievements.summary: Complete 40 substories.

guide.context: There are 51 substories in total, and any unfinished ones can still be done in Premium Adventure after the story.

steps.text: Finish substories until 40 of the 51 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete all 51 substories.

guide.context: The last substory, Jo Amon, opens near the end of the finale only after substories #24 and #50 are complete. Finish everything else before starting it.

steps.text: Clear every substory from #1 to #50, then complete the Amon substory in the finale.

achievements.summary: Complete 5 different types of Troublr missions.

guide.context: Troublr is a phone app added early in Chapter 2. Every named incident counts once as a type, and a notice you miss will appear again later.

steps.text: Open the Troublr app, travel to the marked spot, and settle the incident there. Repeat this for five different incidents.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 different types of Troublr missions.

guide.context: Troublr hosts more than 40 named incidents, including multi-part chains such as Shake Up the Shakedown Squad, the Alight fires and Menace to the Middle-aged. Each distinct incident counts once.

steps.text: Keep answering Troublr notices around Kamurocho and Onomichi until you have cleared 20 distinct incidents.

achievements.summary: Activate Extreme Heat Mode 10 times.

guide.context: Extreme Heat is entered with R2 or RT once at least one Heat orb is full. Each use empties your remaining orbs.

steps.text: Build at least one Heat orb by fighting, press R2 or RT to trigger Extreme Heat Mode, and repeat until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.summary: Escape from 10 street fights after combat has started.

guide.context: Only fights that have already begun count. Slipping past thugs before they engage Kiryu does not add to the total.

steps.text: Walk into a group of street thugs and let them start the fight.
Run away and break their line of sight using an alley, a staircase, a shop or a building until the fight ends.
Repeat this escape 10 times.

achievements.summary: Obtain 10 skills.

guide.context: Skills are permanent abilities bought with experience in the Stats menu.

steps.text: Open the Stats menu and buy abilities with experience until 10 have been learned.

achievements.summary: Obtain 25 skills.

guide.context: Abilities draw on all five experience types, so spread your spending across combat and stat upgrades.

steps.text: Keep buying abilities in the Stats menu until 25 skills are learned.

achievements.summary: Obtain every skill in the Stats menu.

guide.context: This is the most expensive skill goal: it needs large amounts of every experience colour and covers the whole ability tree.

steps.text: Buy every ability in the Stats menu until no purchasable skills remain.

achievements.summary: Raise Health to a natural 150.

guide.context: Natural means the value from purchased stat increases, before any gear bonus.

steps.text: In the Stats menu, spend Red and Yellow experience on Health until it reads 150.

achievements.summary: Raise Attack to a natural 150.

guide.context: Natural means the value from purchased stat increases, before any gear bonus.

steps.text: In the Stats menu, spend Red experience on Attack until it reads 150.

achievements.summary: Raise Defense to a natural 150.

guide.context: Natural means the value from purchased stat increases, before any gear bonus.

steps.text: In the Stats menu, spend Yellow and Green experience on Defense until it reads 150.

achievements.summary: Raise Evade to a natural 150.

guide.context: Natural means the value from purchased stat increases, before any gear bonus.

steps.text: In the Stats menu, spend Blue experience on Evade until it reads 150.

achievements.description: Raised the Heat Gauge to a natural 150.
achievements.summary: Buy stat increases until the Heat Gauge reaches 150 on its own.

guide.context: Natural means the value from purchased stat increases, before any gear bonus.

steps.text: In the Stats menu, spend Green and Purple experience on the Heat Gauge until it reads 150.

achievements.description: Raised all stats to a natural 200.
achievements.summary: Raise all five stats to a natural 200.

guide.context: Taking every stat to 200 triggers the Limit Break, the event that lets you keep buying increases above 200.

steps.text: Buy stat increases until Health, Attack, Defense, Evade and the Heat Gauge all read 200.

achievements.description: Raised all stats to a natural 300.
achievements.summary: Raise all five stats to a natural 300.

guide.context: Only possible after the Limit Break at 200. Each increase past 200 also costs a flat 30 Purple experience on top of the usual points.

steps.text: After reaching 200 everywhere, keep buying increases until all five stats read 300.

achievements.summary: Defeat Jo Amon in the finale.

guide.context: Amon is the boss of Substory #51, which only opens in the finale after Substories #24 (Sodachi) and #50 (Saigo) are done. This is the hardest fight in the game.

steps.text: In the finale, speak with Nagumo up on the Serena rooftop, then read the text beside the Serena elevator to begin Substory #51.
Stock healing items, equip strong gear, and grab a vending-machine drink that raises attack before heading out.
Take a taxi to Amon's Island and defeat Jo Amon.
Break Amon's orange shield by waiting for a Roomba to start beeping, picking it up, and throwing it at him.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 1,000 experience points.

guide.context: Experience is counted as a running total across the whole save, so this comes from ordinary play.

steps.text: Fight enemies, eat, and play activities until 1,000 experience has been earned in total.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 10,000 experience points.

guide.context: Experience is counted as a running total across the whole save.

steps.text: Keep fighting and completing activities until 10,000 experience has been earned in total.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 100,000 experience points.

guide.context: This is the long-term total for the save. RIZAP LIMIT+ powder gives 50 Green experience per purchase, and repeat fights against Sodachi and Saigo are the best single source of Red, Blue and Yellow experience.

steps.text: Keep earning experience from fights, food and minigames until the save total passes 100,000.

achievements.description: Completed 10 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: The Completion List is the list of Awards split into Adventure, Battle, Substories, Minigames and Clan Creator. Any item in any category counts.

steps.text: Open the Completion menu and finish 10 items.

achievements.description: Completed 31 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 31 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: The Completion List covers five categories, and the simplest early items are travel, eating, fortune draws and street-fight totals.

steps.text: Keep completing Awards until 31 items are done.

achievements.description: Completed 100 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: This is the bulk of the game's optional content: all substories, the full minigame category, most Clan Creator goals and the Adventure and Battle tallies.

steps.text: Finish Awards across all five categories until 100 items are complete.

achievements.summary: Assemble the Kiryu Clan.

guide.context: Clan Creator is introduced automatically in Chapter 5, when the first Clan Battle starts and Kiryu forms the clan.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 story until the first Clan Battle begins; the achievement unlocks as the clan is formed.

achievements.description: Reached level 3 in the Kiryu Clan.
achievements.summary: Raise the Kiryu Clan to level 3.

guide.context: The clan level appears at the top right of the Clan Creator screen and climbs as you clear Clan Missions.

steps.text: Clear Clan Missions from the Missions menu until the clan level shown on the Clan Creator screen reaches 3.

achievements.summary: Complete the Kiryu Clan storyline.

guide.context: The storyline runs across an Onomichi mission chain and then a Kamurocho chain. Both chains have to be finished to complete it.

steps.text: Clear every Story Mission in the Onomichi and Kamurocho Clan Creator mission lists.

achievements.description: Raised the Kiryu Clan's influence to 10,000.
achievements.summary: Build the Kiryu Clan's influence up to 10,000.

guide.context: Influence is the clan's reputation total and rises from winning Clan Battles and clearing Clan Missions.

steps.text: Win Clan Battles and clear Clan Missions until the clan's influence reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Maxed out a Kiryu Clan leader's stats.
achievements.summary: Reach level 99 with one Kiryu Clan leader.

guide.context: A leader's level rises from experience earned in battle. Putting one in the hierarchy's Chief Advisor slot multiplies their experience by two, and the Chief of HQ slot multiplies it by 1.5. Cheap leaders such as Masao need far less experience per level.

steps.text: Choose one leader, such as Masao, and place them in a hierarchy experience slot.
Deploy that leader in Clan Battles over and over until they reach level 99.

achievements.description: Achieved 100 victories with the Kiryu Clan.
achievements.summary: Win 100 Kiryu Clan battles.

guide.context: Only victories count toward the total, and progress is tracked in the phone's Clan Creator menu. You can quit a battle you are about to lose so it is not recorded as a loss, but that battle still contributes nothing.

steps.text: Replay quick Clan Missions and win them until the Clan Creator menu shows 100 victories.

achievements.summary: Play every minigame at least once.

guide.context: The game's Minigames completion category covers Karaoke, the Cabaret Club, Bar Chat at Snack New Gaudi, Baseball, the Batting Center, Spearfishing, RIZAP, Darts, Mahjong, the Cat Cafe, the Club SEGA arcade games and Live Chat.

steps.text: Start each of these activities at least once: karaoke, cabaret club, bar chat, baseball, batting center, spearfishing, RIZAP, darts, mahjong, cat cafe, a Club SEGA game, and live chat.

achievements.summary: Complete every RIZAP training exercise.

guide.context: RIZAP Gym is in Kamurocho. The trainer offers six exercise programs, each with its own control scheme and experience rewards.

steps.text: Speak to the RIZAP trainer and complete all six training exercises.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Emperor Squid in spearfishing.

guide.context: Substory #47, titled The Old Man and the Sea, unlocks the spearfishing minigame. It appears in Chapter 4 during the daytime at the end of the southern dock in Onomichi.

steps.text: In Chapter 4, go to the end of the southern dock in Onomichi in daylight and examine the pair of fish on the ground to start Substory #47.
Follow the substory into the spearfishing minigame, win the opening course, then take down the Emperor Squid.

achievements.description: Reached Beloved Customer rank at Snack New Gaudi.
achievements.summary: Become a Beloved Customer at Snack New Gaudi.

guide.context: Snack New Gaudi sits in eastern Hana-no-kubo in Onomichi and opens in Chapter 5 after Substory #35. Each visit costs a 3,000 yen cover charge, and you raise every patron's Friendship Gauge to three hearts before playing out their conversation.

steps.text: Visit Snack New Gaudi repeatedly and drink and talk with every patron until each Friendship Gauge reaches three hearts.
Finish each patron's conversation scene, then keep visiting until the bar ranks Kiryu as a Beloved Customer.

achievements.summary: Request every hostess at the Cabaret Club.

guide.context: The club has five hostesses: Saki, Riona, Erina, Hikaru and Sora.

steps.text: At the Cabaret Club, request each of the five hostesses at least once.

achievements.description: Chatted with both lovely Live Chat ladies.
achievements.summary: Chat with both women in Live Chat.

guide.context: Live Chat runs at the internet cafes in Kamurocho. You do not have to succeed at the chat; simply finishing a session with each woman is enough.

steps.text: Buy chat points and complete one session with each of the two Live Chat women.

achievements.displayName: To Be This Good Takes AGES
achievements.summary: Play every game in the Club SEGA arcades.

guide.context: Both Club SEGA arcades are in Kamurocho, and starting a game then quitting immediately still counts.

steps.text: At Club SEGA, start each game once: Fantasy Zone, Out Run, Puyo Puyo, Space Harrier, Super Hang-On and Virtua Fighter 5 FS.

achievements.summary: Rescue three stray cats for the cat cafe.

guide.context: Stray cats appear on the streets from Chapter 2 and are taken in by the Nyan Nyan Cat Cafe on Senryo Ave. Each cat has favourite foods, and Gold Tuna is liked by all of them.

steps.text: Find a stray cat on the street and feed it its favourite food up to three times to fill its Friendship Gauge.
Repeat with two more stray cats so the cafe takes in three in total.

achievements.summary: Win a baseball game with the Onomichi Warriors.

guide.context: Once Kiryu manages the Warriors, recruit players around Onomichi and take a taxi to the baseball field to play a game.

steps.text: Take a taxi to the baseball field, play a full game with the Warriors, and win it.

achievements.description: Experienced the trials of raising a baby.
achievements.summary: Settle baby Haruto during the story.

guide.context: This happens in the story segment where Kiryu searches Onomichi for milk. It is the only technically missable achievement, but the calm-down minigame repeats many times and is very lenient.

steps.text: When Haruto starts crying, respond to his movements with the action shown on screen and fill the bar.

achievements.summary: Draw a Great Blessing fortune at the temple.

guide.context: Fortunes cost 100 yen at the kiosk beside the offering box at Senkoji Temple in Onomichi. The result is random, and Great Blessing sits just below Supreme Blessing.

steps.text: Buy fortunes at the Senkoji Temple kiosk and keep drawing until you pull a Great Blessing.

achievements.description: Made a store employee angry at you.
achievements.summary: Make a store employee angry at you.

guide.context: This has to be done in a Kamurocho shop.

steps.text: Pick a fight with street thugs in Kamurocho.
Lead the fight into a shop such as a Poppo and break merchandise inside.
After the fight ends, talk to the clerk to be scolded and unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Find a secret passage.

steps.text: Walk into a tight-squeeze gap between buildings and come out the other side.

achievements.description: Jumped from a dangerously high place.
achievements.summary: Jump from a dangerously high place.

steps.text: Climb to the rooftop of the Cat Cafe building on Senryo Ave. and jump off on the street side.

achievements.description: Activated five types of eatery combos.
achievements.summary: Activate five different eatery combos.

guide.context: A combo triggers when you order its exact set of dishes in one sitting at the same eatery. Completed combos are tracked on the Awards list.

steps.text: Order one full combo set in a single restaurant visit. For example, at Cafe Alps order the Sandwich Set and Strawberry Parfait.
Repeat with four more combo sets at any eateries until five different combos have triggered.

achievements.description: Took a photo of Ono Michio-kun.
achievements.summary: Take a photo of Ono Michio-kun.

guide.context: The three Ono Michio substories (#29 Oh No! It's Ono Michio!, #30 The Ono Michio Show and #31 Putting on a Brave Face) have to be completed first. After that he roams Onomichi near the Ropeway, by the shopping centre, or at the Hana-no-kubo street corner.

steps.text: Complete the three Ono Michio substories so he starts appearing around Onomichi.
Find Ono Michio in person and press Confirm near him to take his photo.

achievements.description: Engaged enemies while a drink's effect is active.
achievements.summary: Fight enemies while a drink effect is active.

guide.context: Some vending-machine drinks grant a short-lived combat effect such as an attack boost.

steps.text: Buy and drink a vending-machine drink that grants an effect.
Before the effect expires, walk into street thugs and start a fight.

achievements.summary: Walk for 30 seconds in first-person view.

guide.context: First-person view is toggled with R3 and does not count while the phone camera is up.

steps.text: Press R3 to enter first-person view and walk around for 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Got surrounded by enemies while trying to take a picture.
achievements.summary: Get surrounded by enemies while in camera mode.

steps.text: Stand near hostile street thugs and open the phone's camera mode.
Wait for the enemies to close in and surround Kiryu while the camera is open.
